injuries.name: Gary Payton II
injuries.comment: Payton (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.comment: Williams has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against the Pelicans due to a left hamstring injury, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports. He'll finish with four points (2-3 FG) in two minutes.

injuries.name: Will Richard
injuries.comment: Richard is deciding between getting surgery or playing with a splint, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
